words.headline: Thursday Timber: Rain Drops Trees, Damaged-Tree Calls Hit 260
words.blurb: With 1.61 inches of rain coming down on Thursday, 50 people reported an entire tree lying across the street, against a usual 2. Inside, no-heat calls more than doubled to 2,233 as the low dipped to 42.

boroughs.Bronx: No heat led with 841 calls, well ahead of home repairs at 479.
boroughs.Brooklyn: Parking wars topped the list at 640, with no heat close behind at 598.
boroughs.Manhattan: No heat came first with 441 calls, ahead of noise at 354.
boroughs.Queens: Parking wars ruled with 730 calls, double home repairs at 349.
boroughs.Staten Island: Parking wars led with 83 calls, while water and sewers (35) and trees (31) followed.

rare_finds.name: Monkey
rare_finds.quip: First one in 28 days. Somewhere a form field marked 'monkey' has finally earned its keep, and it will not let anyone forget it.

rare_finds.name: Farm animal
rare_finds.quip: BULLETIN: Livestock report logged. Agency convening a working group to define 'farm.' The animal has not been invited to testify.

rare_finds.name: Crash cushion defect
rare_finds.quip: The city owns cushions built for being crashed into, plus a process for when they disappoint. Softness remains pending review.
